q: How can I find the nearest RBL Bank branch?
a: You can find the nearest RBL Bank branch by using the Branch Locator on the Contact Us page. Alternatively, use the RBL Cares Chatbot and select Banking Services → Branch Locator.

q: How do I contact RBL Bank for account-related queries?
a: You can contact RBL Bank Customer Care at +91 22 6232 7777 or use the Raise a Query / Request / Complaint feature on the website.

q: Can I contact RBL Bank for credit card support?
a: Yes, for credit card support including billing, payments, and activation, contact Customer Care at +91 22 6232 7777 or raise a request via the website.

q: How do I submit feedback or complaints to RBL Bank?
a: You can submit feedback or complaints using the Raise a Query / Request / Complaint feature on the website.

q: My RBL Bank account was closed without notification. What can I do?
a: Please contact Customer Care at +91 22 6232 7777 to understand the reason for the account closure.

q: What if RBL Bank Customer Care is not responding?
a: If Customer Care is not responding, submit your request using the online complaint form for quicker resolution.

q: I am being harassed by RBL Bank recovery agents. What should I do?
a: If you experience harassment from collection agents, report it using the online complaint form on the website.

q: How do I get my RBL Bank loan statement or resolve repayment issues?
a: For loan statements or repayment issues, contact Customer Care at +91 22 6232 7777 or submit your request via the website.

q: My RBL Bank transaction failed but money was deducted. What should I do?
a: In case of a failed transaction, the amount is usually reversed within 7–10 business days. If not, contact Customer Care at +91 22 6232 7777.
